title: VOLTHAVEN
note: Root cause found and fixed: the PMREM environment map was turning every MeshStandardMaterial black — that single bug was the unlit road, the flat facades AND the invisible characters. Game now boots straight into a walkable, vibrant Volthaven with a third-person player.
blockers: GitHub repo creation returned 403 (no repo-creation scope). Work is on claude/cyberpunk-threejs-game-aytbja in clonevpn333-bot/game.
cdnjs blocked by egress; shipped HTML targets cdnjs, capture harness serves an identical r128 locally.
WebSearch/WebFetch DO work (curl does not) — reference research is available and is now used.

pieces.name: Render core & post FX
pieces.gap: Post chain working end to end. Fixed this pass: PMREM env map poisoning all standard materials; volumetric in-scatter with no scattering coefficient; bloom summing ~30x across mips. Grade warmed and saturated (sat 1.42) per direction that Night City is vibrant, not dreary. Remaining: sky is an empty void, needs city glow and distant towers.

shots.label: Raw scene buffer (pre-post)
shots.note: This is the geometry and lighting before post — dark street, lit windows, warm glow down the canyon.

shots.label: Final composite, Undertide
shots.note: Post chain applied. Sky too bright, road under-lit — the current largest gap.

pieces.name: Procedural materials
pieces.gap: Wet asphalt now visibly mirrors coloured signage. Albedos rebalanced twice — first authored far too dark to ever light. Remaining: puddle edges are soft blobs rather than shaped water.

pieces.name: City generation
pieces.gap: Undertide vibrant and dense at ~254 draw calls: per-building wall material variety, neon shopfront strips, painted colour bands, five lamp colour temperatures, blade signs. Remaining: no crowds, no vehicles, and six districts still unrendered.

shots.label: Undertide after vibrancy pass
shots.note: Colour variety, neon strips, blade signs, wet reflections.

pieces.name: Characters & animation
pieces.gap: Characters visible and correctly skinned. Two real bugs fixed: three r128 routes 20 bones through a float vertex texture that returns zeros on this driver (switched to CPU skinning), and the env map was blackening the materials. Remaining: animation not yet graded on a contact sheet.

shots.label: Seven archetypes, skinned
shots.note: Distinct silhouettes: coat, vest, shield, sniper, brute, robe, civilian.

pieces.name: Combat & trackpad control
pieces.gap: Written and playable: trackpad camera (cursor-X yaw with dead zone, no pointer lock), WASD movement with accel/decel, capsule-vs-box collision, camera collision, three weapons, hitscan with falloff and headshots, tracers, impacts, dash with i-frames, melee, Focus slow-mo. Not yet tuned for feel; no enemies to fight yet.

shots.label: Playable: Kas in Volthaven
shots.note: Third person, trackpad camera, walking down the Undertide.

log.detail: GPU bone-texture path returns zeros on this driver; switched to CPU skinning. Characters render.
ROOT CAUSE: PMREM env map blackened every MeshStandardMaterial. One bug behind the dark road, flat buildings and invisible characters.
Player controller online — game boots into a walkable Volthaven in third person.
Wrote 20_materials.js and 30_world.js directly (no subagents). First city street renders.

Root-caused the white-frame bug with a render-target pixel probe: volumetric in-scatter accumulated light with no scattering coefficient, and bloom summed ~30x across six mips. Both fixed; raw scene buffer confirmed correct.
Ten builders launched in parallel across ten files.
All ten terminated: account session limit exhausted. Root cause is fan-out width, not any individual agent.
Salvaged 10_core.js (1537 lines, sound architecture) and 70_story.js (509 lines, 4 missions). 50_combat.js was truncated and reverted to stub.
